setup: const { ColossusLab } = await import('/src/dev/colossus_lab.js'); const lab = new ColossusLab(g); window.__lab = lab; const st = lab.studio(); const b = await lab.build('procesion'); lab.place(b, 0, 0, 0, 0, st); lab.atmo('studio'); window.__colTick = (dt) => lab.tick(dt); g.player.spawn(8, 0, 30, -0.6); st.add(g.player.obj); window.__colRender = () => lab.renderStudio(); return { ms: b.ms, info: b.info, stats: b.model.stats() };
